# hyperfluid_alert_threshold (Resource)

Overrides the platform's warning and critical thresholds of a capacity signal for the organization. Needs the organization's `alerting_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Warn earlier than the platform default on persistent volume usage.
# Destroying the resource returns the signal to the platform defaults.
resource "hyperfluid_alert_threshold" "pvc_disk" {
  signal       = "pvc_disk"
  warning_pct  = 70
  critical_pct = 85
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `critical_pct` (Number) Usage percentage that raises a critical alert.
- `signal` (String) `pvc_disk` or `bucket_quota`.
- `warning_pct` (Number) Usage percentage that raises a warning; below `critical_pct`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Alert threshold import id is the signal: pvc_disk or bucket_quota. Only a
# signal the organization overrides can be imported.
terraform import hyperfluid_alert_threshold.pvc_disk pvc_disk
```
